device.name: Keychron M6
state.denied: No access: install the udev rule
sensor.motionSyncDesc: Aligns sensor reads with USB polling. Adds a little latency.
sensor.rippleDesc: Smooths jitter at high DPI. Adds a little latency.
hscroll.label: Thumb wheel speed
hscroll.note: Stored on the mouse, so it works on every computer. Remapping the thumb wheel under Buttons replaces it.
accel.label: Acceleration
scroll.label: Scroll speed
accel.note: Set in Hyprland for this computer only. Needs the line from the README in ~/.config/hypr/input.lua.
buttons.empty: Button settings load when the mouse answers.
settings.unavailable: Connect the receiver or the cable to change mouse settings.
reset.confirm: Click again to reset the mouse
reset.note: Resets DPI, polling rate, buttons, and sleep on the mouse.
